Name: Sea Monster Alert
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
This mod adds visual and audio notice when the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Secrets#Beach_Creature]rare green sea creature[/url] appears at the beach. Created for the winter 2023 Stardew Discord team event to support the Crocus Crew finding the green sea creature!

Config options:[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b]doBeachWarp[/b][/font]: ﻿(defaults to false) warps you to the beach in front of Willy's shop at the start of the day, for maximum creature spotting time
[*][font=Courier New][b]doScream[/b][/font]: adds the shrieking bat sound effect when the sea monster appears
[*][font=Courier New][b]showMessage[/b][/font]: adds an onscreen alert message when the sea monster appears
[*][font=Courier New][b]takeScreenshot[/b][/font]: automatically takes a screenshot of the beach when the sea monster appears (adds a small lag spike when it takes the screenshot due to the game's screenshot process being intensive)
[*][font=Courier New][b]forceSpawn[/b][/font]: ﻿(defaults to false) forces the sea monster to spawn (for testing purposes)
[/list]
Source: [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/SeaMonsterAlert/]https://github.com/elizabethcd/SeaMonsterAlert/[/url]
